gloss: to show off; to try to look cool

definitions.gloss: to show off; to try to look cool; to put on airs
definitions.explanation: To deliberately behave or dress in a way intended to impress others, often with the implication of being somewhat vain or pretentious.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格好|かっこう}つけなくて⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You don't have to show off like that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{格好|かっこう}つけたがる。
examples.english: He likes to show off in front of girls.

examples.japanese: {格好|かっこう}つけないで、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Instead of trying to look cool, you should just be honest and ask for help.

notes:
A colloquial expression used when someone is consciously trying to appear impressive, stylish, or tough. Often carries a mildly critical or teasing nuance, implying the person is being somewhat fake or pretentious. Very common in casual conversation, especially among younger speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格好|かっこう}つけたがる: to like showing off
- {格好|かっこう}つけないで: stop trying to look cool
- {格好|かっこう}つけて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak in a showy way
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{格好|かっこう}つけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: always trying to look cool

USAGE:
The shortened form かっこ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ is also very common in casual speech. Conjugates as an ichidan verb: {格好|かっこう}つけない (negative), {格好|かっこう}つけて (te-form), etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気取|きど}る: to put on airs, to act affected (slightly more literary; focuses on pretending to be refined)
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る→見栄を張る：15322_miewoharu⟧: to keep up appearances, to put on a show (emphasizes doing things beyond one's means to impress)
- ⟦{背伸|せの}び→背伸び：13930_senobi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stretch beyond one's abilities, to try to appear more capable than one is
